title: Implement API key usage
body: Hello! Claude and I threw this together quickly, it's just the bare minimum, hopefully it's up to standards.
author: Jefferderp

comments.body: It did just occur to me that the GUI at `/web` doesn't implement API key usage. *facepalm*

Hi @Jefferderp ,

Thanks for putting this together—and I appreciate the effort you and Claude put into it. I had a look through the implementation, and while I can see where it’s headed, I think it’s a bit early to merge.

Right now, the approach doesn’t fully integrate with the existing /web UI or broader auth flow, and I’d prefer a more cohesive implementation that handles both backend and frontend usage consistently. Since this repo serves as a backend-first utility, adding partial key support without complete coverage could create confusion or unexpected behavior for users.

I’m going to pass on merging this specific PR, but I definitely encourage you to revisit it if you’d like to expand it to cover full API key handling—including frontend validation and proper fallback behavior. I’d be happy to provide some notes if you go that route.

Appreciate the contribution either way!

Hi!

Just a heads up—I don’t run any scripts or deployments directly from my git environment, so a .gitignore isn’t needed in this case.

Appreciate the contribution though—feel free to ping me if you have any other PRs down the line!
It's not for you it's for me/other users xd. Without it just by following the instructions users end up with their github desktop/whatever polluted with a bunch of files.

title: Dockerized version
body:
Hi, thanks for sharing Orpheus! 

I'm curious if there are any plans for dockerized version or pre-built images of the service so that it's easier to integrate
author: av

comments.body:
Hi, thanks so much for the kind words!

At the moment, there aren’t any plans for a Dockerised version or pre-built images—but I really appreciate the suggestion, and I’ll definitely keep it in mind (a few people have requested it now).

I know you closed this with a comment, but it would be great to have the dockerised version. 
nevertheless thanks for the great work

title: some words cutting out
body:
Some words and small parts of sentences are being randomly cut from the speech.. 
I've tried with Q4 and Q8 models. Same thing was happening with the openai fork. any ideas ?
author: Mellzor

comments.body:
Hi!

The underlying model has some constraints in terms of how it processes tokens. We can tweak min frames, but process every is hardcoded at 7.

I've addressed this with a slight tweak so it performs much better in terms of unprocessed tokens (missed speech, etc).
